attempt_cap_sensitivity_note: The published objective caps the attempt penalty at 15 extra attempts, so anything past 16 attempts/payment is free. deg1 averages 26-92 attempts/payment on every tier and is therefore pinned at the cap everywhere. Re-scoring at cap 30/60/uncapped erases its only directional tier lead (atomic_test) and inverts it; the champions are cap-insensitive (hb1 hard_test 0.586/0.585/0.585/0.585).

determinism_check.note: deg1 and mx_c3 each re-run twice on hard_test__deg/ex_000.json; success/attempts/fee identical to 6dp both times.

deg1_failure_mode.finding: deg1 breaks the give_up_rate == 1 - success_rate identity that holds for every other candidate. Its give-up rate is 0.000-0.090 while its failure rate is 0.083-0.397, so it fails almost entirely by hitting routing/sim_run.go's simMaxAttempts=200 ceiling rather than by returning an error. It never abandons; the harness abandons for it.

caveats: split_test deg1-minus-seed (+0.144 clean / +0.150 deg) has a bootstrap CI excluding zero but a sign test of exactly 4/4 (p=1.000): it is a magnitude result on half the files, not a consistent one.
n = 8-10 files per tier, as on every prior sweep.
